headings.text: Pantheon Overview: The Imprisoned Gods of Belavadös
Belavadös Race Families and Their Creator Gods

Sigrananna is recorded as the single creator-god of the Elven-Types category: Elf and Kaluseban. Elf and Kaluseban are separate parent races. Elf has 15 established bloodlines; Kaluseban has six bundled custom bloodlines that are never treated as Elf bloodlines. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so forests, moonlight, wilderness, graceful hunters, elven beauty, and inherited elven bloodlines never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Marduthor is recorded as the single creator-god of the Dwarven and Gnomish Kin category: Dwarf, Gnome, and Deep Gnome. Dwarf retains Duergar as its established bloodline. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so invention, craft, metalwork, stonework, tools, and underground halls never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Canonical race-compendium doctrine: Valkhamesh holds this single creator category through draconic power, sovereignty, thunder-blood, scales, storms, and ancient dominion. The canonical parent races are Dragonborn, Kobold, Lizardfolk, Yuan-Ti, and Tortle. Dragonborn retains nine project-specific bloodlines. Temple language preserves reverence, but its colder margins classify each race, bloodline, lineage, and form by yield, pressure, environment, devotion, fear, beauty, endurance, and the particular note it awakens in the god's appetite.

Canonical race-compendium doctrine: Freyseth holds this single creator category through crossroads, curses, planar mysteries, infernal and celestial blood, and supernatural inheritance. The canonical parent races are Aasimar, Tiefling, Hexblood, Accursed, and Curseborn. Tiefling retains Feral as its established bloodline. Temple language preserves reverence, but its colder margins classify each race, bloodline, lineage, and form by yield, pressure, environment, devotion, fear, beauty, endurance, and the particular note it awakens in the god's appetite.

Canonical race-compendium doctrine: Nefarokir holds this single creator category through death, the underworld, restless spirits, funerary memory, and the forgotten dead. The canonical parent races are Dhampir, Darakhul, Reborn, Arisen, Graveborn, Shade, and Downcast. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category. Temple language preserves reverence, but its colder margins classify each race, bloodline, lineage, and form by yield, pressure, environment, devotion, fear, beauty, endurance, and the particular note it awakens in the god's appetite.

Thalunesh is recorded as the single creator-god of the Fey-Folk category: Faerie, Fairy, Gandirosha, Changeling, Lorwyn Changeling, Satyr, and Dreamer. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so trickery, shapeshifting, wandering, dreams, glamour, and magical mischief never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Canonical race-compendium doctrine: Horundar holds this single creator category through storms, seas, earthquakes, floods, flame, stone, air, and raw elemental force. The canonical parent races are Genasi, Elemental Kin, Elementborn, and Panolima. Genasi has four bloodlines, Elemental Kin has two, Elementborn has six, and Panolima has five bundled custom bloodlines. Temple language preserves reverence, but its colder margins classify each race, bloodline, lineage, and form by yield, pressure, environment, devotion, fear, beauty, endurance, and the particular note it awakens in the god's appetite.

Raeshkul is recorded as the single creator-god of the Psionic, Astral, and Alien Minds category: Kalashtar, Githyanki, Githzerai, Disembodied, and Gwynis. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so intellect, strategy, psionic discipline, alien logic, dream insight, and higher understanding never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Iskareth is recorded as the single creator-god of the Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs category: Harengon, Leonin, Loxodon, Tabaxi, Bearfolk, Canisar, Cervan, Erina, Mapach, Ratatosk, Rakin, Sattare, Vulpin, Geisamahi, Hadozee, Giff, Gnoll, Shifter, Centaur, and Minotaur. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so beasts, fertility, instinct, mammalian kinship, predation, territory, and natural bonds never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Bastveig is recorded as the single creator-god of the Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples category: Triton, Locathah, Grung, Merfolk, Sahuagin, Lotol, Nakudama, Dril'thar, and Tamhiogal. Dril'thar has six canonical bloodlines—Grassland, Lush Forest, Marsh, Rainforest, Ocean, and Reef—and every Dril'thar bloodline can breathe underwater. The public hymn calls this lineage and blessing; the older register reads like curated divine husbandry, sorting bodies, habitats, temperaments, and spirit-resonance so tides, reefs, hidden waters, currents, amphibious life, and oceanic civilizations never depends on one mortal pattern alone.

Canonical race-compendium doctrine: Hathruna holds this single creator category through seasonal rebirth, decay, fungi, roots, plant life, compost, and living wilderness. The canonical parent races are Mandrake, Mycelian, Gnarlborn, and Harvestborn. No additional canonical bloodline, lineage, or non-bloodline form menu is assigned to this category. Temple language preserves reverence, but its colder margins classify each race, bloodline, lineage, and form by yield, pressure, environment, devotion, fear, beauty, endurance, and the particular note it awakens in the god's appetite.
